entity.name: Myeongseok Kang
entity.description: Independent developer in Seoul, South Korea, and the creator and sole maintainer of claude-bulkhead, an MIT-licensed set of hooks that keeps coding agents from damaging each other when several sessions share one machine.

projects.name: claude-bulkhead
projects.description: Hooks for a machine shared by many coding agent sessions and subagents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, opencode and others). It blocks rm -rf on an empty variable, pkill of another session's dev server, taking another session's port, and git add -A committing another session's edits, and it tracks which session owns which process, port and git worktree. JavaScript, zero runtime dependencies, README in 6 languages.

plans.name: Maintainer time and security work for one year
plans.description: Full-time maintainer time for one year: end-to-end tests with real agent sessions on Linux, Windows and macOS, a published threat model and an external security review of the hook code, support for more coding agents, documentation in more languages, and a hardened release process.
